list_users: list all users on the LiteLLM proxy server with their ID, email, role, and teams
get_user: get information about a specific user by providing the user ID
create_user: create a new user with email, role, optional alias, teams, and max budget
delete_user: delete one or more users by specifying their user IDs
manage_users: manage users on the LiteLLM proxy server via CLI commands for list, get, create, and delete
